name: Czechia
headline: Czechia: +2.6% growth in 2025, 2.5% inflation, debt 44% of GDP
sections: Czechia is a $392 billion economy (2025), the world's 43rd-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +2.6% in 2025, slower than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $60K at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 19.4% of GDP (2025).

Consumer prices rose 2.5% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 15.1% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 2.8% (2025), below the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 9.2% (2025).
Gross government debt is 44% of GDP (2025), a moderate level that has risen from 37% in 2020. The general government balance is −2.1% of GDP (2025).
The current account balance is +0.7% of GDP (2025). Trade equals 128% of GDP (2025), a highly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 2.7% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 55% of GDP by 2031, still rising from today's level. Life expectancy is 80.0 years (2024). Population: 10.8 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
